name: Quotations And Allusions
overview: Scripture reveals the foundational truth that God created humanity in His own image, establishing the dignity and purpose of man and woman as seen in Genesis 1:27. The creation account further emphasizes God's intentional design in forming man from the dust and breathing life into him, making him a living soul (Genesis 2:7). God's ordained order for human relationships is also evident, as a man is to leave his parents and unite with his wife, becoming one flesh (Genesis 2:24). Additionally, God's sovereign guidance and covenantal promises to Abraham highlight His active role in directing and blessing His people (Genesis 12:1, 3). These verses collectively show how New Testament quotations and allusions draw from these Old Testament truths to affirm God's unchanging purposes and the believer's identity in Christ.
